issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 07 requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses thresholds of 7,500 (einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500). This numeric mismatch contradicts the specification and would confuse students about the intended cutoff.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Either change the solution to use the 75,000 threshold (WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000) to match the problem statement, or update the problem text to specify 7,500 if that was the intended value. Ensure both template, problem description, and solution use the same value.
